{{Top|leg|title=''Kalld'n''-class stardrive}}
The '''''Kalld'n''-class stardrive''' was a rare stardrive. Only fifty were ever created and forty-three of them were accounted for by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. Planetary [[Baron/Legends|baron]] [[Marshal/Legends|Marshal]] [[Levnis]] sought a ''Kalld'n''-class stardrive for his personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Lady Akiko]]'', and employed [[The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers]] to obtain it for him.
